mandate: C320 — test the cross-sectional INTRADAY TIME-OF-DAY / DAY-OF-WEEK SEASONALITY mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1440 pre-registered configs). Signals (score = -seasonal-mispricing, long seasonally-low / short seasonally-high): tod_dev (return vs trailing same-tod mean), tod_z (z of that deviation vs trailing dev std), dow_dev (return vs trailing same dow+bar mean), tod_rv (vol-scaled seasonal deviation), tod_ewm (return vs causal ewm same-tod baseline). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs charged on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy variants). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and seasonal-vs-placebo attribution.

methodology.buckets: bar-of-day (tod)=seconds-of-day//300 (0..287, one per day); day-of-week+bar (dow)=dayofweek*288+tod (0..2015, one per week); grid[0]=2023-01-01 00:00 UTC.
methodology.signals: tod_dev=-(r-mean_L(r at same tod)); tod_z=-dev/std_L(dev at same tod); dow_dev=-(r-mean_L(r at same dow+bar)); tod_rv=-dev/std_L(r at same tod) (vol-scaled); tod_ewm=-(r-ewm_mean_L(r at same tod, causal)). lookback L in days applied as trailing L seasonal occurrences, min_periods=L (fail-closed). score=-mispricing (long seasonally-low/short seasonally-high); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i (pos>0 long).
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute; a lookback without enough valid observations yields NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs flat (0); Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1440 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config seasonal nets vs placebo_noise (per-asset randomly permuted perp returns, same reference positions); shares = |net| / sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.funding: USDT-M funding unreachable (fapi 451, not in archives) -> excluded (control only).
